review_evidence: README identifies the project as a Nova implementation in Lean.

A complete scan of all 13 Lean files found 61 declaration-style lines. Nova/SNARK/R1CS.lean defines R1CS shapes, witnesses, instances, relaxed instances/witnesses and folding operations; Nova/SNARK/NIFS.lean defines the non-interactive folding scheme and its construction.
These R1CS/Nova data structures and cryptographic constructions are directly reusable formal prior art even though this revision is implementation-oriented and contains no theorem/lemma declarations.
summary: Reviewed Nova.lean and retain its formal cryptographic structures and constructions for R1CS, relaxed R1CS, folding, commitments and NIFS.
